cheek 0.2.0 writes covers and tags into every file and resumes HLS and DASH fragment downloads.

- `--embed-thumbnail` puts the thumbnail into the file as its cover: an attached picture in MP4, M4A, MOV, MP3 and FLAC, an attachment in MKV and a picture block in Opus and Ogg comments. WebP thumbnails become JPEG first. A thumbnail that can't be fetched doesn't fail the download.
- `--embed-metadata` writes title, artist and link even into files that needed no other ffmpeg step, such as an M4A that was already M4A. That step reports the new `tagging` stage.
- Interrupted HLS and DASH fragment downloads continue from the last fragment written, also when a new resolve brings new tokens for the same fragments.
